chainVerification.description: Verify the integrity of receipt and Z-report fiscal hash chains per terminal.

errors.legacyLinkageBroken: Chain link broken: a receipt does not point to the previous receipt's seal.
errors.sealedHashAlgorithmAnomaly: A receipt carries no seal algorithm although this terminal's seal migration is complete. Contact support with this terminal code.
errors.fiscalHashMismatch: Seal mismatch: this receipt's data no longer matches its fiscal seal.
errors.zReportChainBreak: Z-report chain break: the session chain or the Z-report links do not match.
